transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

I... I guess my family wanted me to come. They think I'm too stressed with the company. But... it's just that I keep hearing things. Like, people talking about me. Sometimes it's through the walls in the conference room, or... or even my phone when it's completely turned off. It's usually the board members or some of the staff. They keep saying I'm ruining the company. It's... it sounds so real. So clear. I've actually answered them out loud before I realized no one else in the room could hear it.
When did you first start hearing these voices? Was it sudden, or did it develop gradually over time?
I... I guess it's been about three months. The ones coming from the walls, or my phone. It just... started.

In the three months before you started hearing these voices, did anything major happen in your life—like a significant loss, conflict, or major change? Or did you start using any new medications, drugs, or alcohol around that time?
No, not really. I mean... work is always stressful, but nothing new happened. And I don't really drink or take anything. Just... normal stuff.

Besides hearing these voices, have you noticed that people seem to be watching you, following you, or that events around you have special meanings directed at you—like the board members are specifically plotting against you or coordinating their actions through these voices?
I... no. I don't think so. Nobody is following me or anything like that. It's just... just the things I hear.

In these past three months, have you noticed any periods where you needed much less sleep than usual but still felt energetic and productive, or where you were unusually talkative or your thoughts seemed to race?
No. I sleep fine. I'm just... tired a lot. I don't get bursts of energy or anything like that.

Over these past three months since the voices started, have you noticed that you've withdrawn from friends or activities you normally enjoy, or that you feel less motivated or emotionally flat—like things just don't matter as much anymore?

I suppose... yes. I don't really do much anymore. I used to be the one driving every idea, you know? Calling people after openings... but now I just... I can sit at my desk for hours, just staring at the agenda. I barely even speak to my husband or my staff. It's just... I don't feel much of anything about the work anymore. Work I used to love. It's just... gone.

When you say you've withdrawn from people and stopped feeling motivated about work—did that happen at the same time the voices started three months ago, or did it develop more gradually before or after the voices began?
I don't really know. It's... hard to keep track. I'm not sure what happened first.

Before you started hearing the voices three months ago, were you already feeling withdrawn, losing interest in work, or feeling emotionally flat? Or did all of that start around the same time as the voices?
I... I really couldn't say. I just... I don't remember the exact timeline. It all just sort of blurs together.

Think back to three months ago, before you started hearing the voices. At that time, were you still enjoying your work and spending time with your husband and staff, or had you already started feeling withdrawn and losing interest in things by then?
I... I told you, I just don't know. Trying to think back to how I felt before is... I can't picture it. I just... I don't have an answer for you.
Looking back three months ago, before the voices started—were you still going to work, interacting normally with your husband and colleagues, and enjoying your job at that time?

I... I don't understand why you keep asking me the exact same thing. I... I can't give you the answer you're looking for. 

I was probably at the office, I guess, but... I don't remember how I felt about it, or who I talked to. It's just... it's all a fog. I really just don't know.

Let me ask this differently. In the month or two before you started hearing voices three months ago, did you notice yourself pulling away from people or losing interest in things—even if you can't remember exactly when the voices began?
I just... I really can't say. I don't know why you're still asking me this. I... I can't remember. I just can't.

When you think about the time before the voices started—say, two or three months ago—do you remember a time when you were still enjoying your work and wanting to talk to people, or does it feel like you've been feeling withdrawn and unmotivated for longer than just these three months?
I... I already told you. I don't know. I can't... I just can't remember it that way. I don't know why you keep asking me the same thing over and over. I don't have anything else to tell you.
Six months ago, before any of this started, were you regularly attending work meetings, initiating projects, and socializing with your husband and colleagues?

Six months... I don't... it's all just the same to me now. 

I was at the company, I suppose. But I don't know about... projects, or whatever else you're asking. I don't keep track of it like that in my head anymore. I just... I really don't have anything else to add about it.
Right now, today, when you think about your life—do you feel like you want to do things, or does everything feel pointless and empty to you?

I just... sit there now. At my desk. 

I used to... I used to be the one pushing everything forward, making the calls after openings, but... now I just stare at the agenda for hours. I don't really talk to my staff anymore. Or my husband. It just... I don't feel anything about the work. The work I used to care about. It's just... empty.

When you think back to four or five months ago—before the voices started—were you still actively leading meetings and making business calls, or had you already started spending more time alone at your desk and feeling less interested in doing those things?

I don't... I don't know exactly when it started. Four months, five months... I can't place it on a timeline like that. 

I just know I'm not doing those things now. I don't remember when I stopped. It's too hard to think back that far.
When you heard your first voice three months ago, were you already feeling withdrawn and not caring about work, or did that empty feeling come after you started hearing the voices?
I'm not sure... I don't know which came first. It all just... runs together now. I really can't sort it out for you.

When you first heard those voices three months ago, had you already been feeling withdrawn and empty for a while before that happened, or did the empty feeling come on around the same time as the voices?
I... I thought I just answered that. I really don't know. I can't give you an order for how it happened. I just... I can't piece it together for you.
When you first heard those voices three months ago, were you able to think clearly and speak normally, or did you notice your thoughts were jumbled or hard to follow around that same time?
I don't know. I can't tell you if my thoughts were clear back then. I just... I don't remember how I was talking.

Let me ask you this way: Right now today, are you having trouble concentrating or organizing your thoughts—like when you're trying to read something or follow a conversation, does it feel harder than it used to, or does your mind feel foggy?
I don't... I don't really know. I'm just trying to get through the day. I haven't really noticed if it's foggy or not.

When you first heard those voices three months ago, in that same week or so, did you also notice that you started feeling withdrawn and empty at that exact time, or had you already been feeling that way for weeks or months before the voices began?
I... I don't know why you keep asking me this. I already said I don't know the order of things. I just... I don't remember when the empty feeling started. I can't give you a timeline.
